panels.title: Prediction requests per second

targets.expr: sum(max by (namespace, pod, endpoint, method, status) (rate(airbnb_http_requests_total{endpoint="/predict"}[5m])))

panels.description: Stable and canary scrapes are deduplicated per pod before summing. Missing series mean awaiting source data, not zero. Event counters require observed events; latency requires predictions in the selected rate window.

panels.title: Total successful predictions (current pods)
panels.description: Counter total for current processes; resets when pods restart. Use rates for traffic history. Missing series mean awaiting source data, not zero. Event counters require observed events; latency requires predictions in the selected rate window.

sum(max by (namespace, pod, endpoint, method, status) (rate(airbnb_http_requests_total{endpoint="/predict",status=~"5.."}[5m])))

panels.title: Prediction latency percentiles

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (max by (namespace, pod, le) (rate(airbnb_prediction_latency_seconds_bucket[5m]))))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (max by (namespace, pod, le) (rate(airbnb_prediction_latency_seconds_bucket[5m]))))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (max by (namespace, pod, le) (rate(airbnb_prediction_latency_seconds_bucket[5m]))))
